items.question: What is the phone number of the UAE Digital Wellbeing Support Line?
items.fact: UAE Digital Wellbeing Support Line phone number is 80091.

items.question: On what date did UAE Federal Decree Law No. 34 of 2021 on Combatting Rumours and Cybercrimes take effect?
items.fact: Federal Decree Law No. 34 of 2021 took effect 2 January 2022.
